newsitem.title: USA: PC Service sees Q2 sales $33 to $35 mln.
newsitem.headline: PC Service sees Q2 sales $33 to $35 mln.

text.p: PC ServiceSource said Tuesday that its outlook for the second quarter is to achieve sales of $33 million to $35 million with earnings per share in the $0.12 to $0.14 range.
For last year's second quarter, the company reported $26.8 million in net revenues.

The company said it is particularly pleased that its selling, general and administrative expenses as a percent of sales decreased from the fourth quarter. The company said it expects the SG&A improvement will continue into the current quarter.
And the company said it expects the combination of its pricing action and marketing initiatives will cause sales to continue to be strong in the current quarter.
